blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Over four years, video generation has passed through several distinct regimes.
In 2023, general-purpose video creation remained largely aspirational. In 2024,
early systems produced compelling demonstrations, but with limited reliability
and control. By 2025, leading models could generate production-usable shots and
creative assets. By 2026, frontier systems
had begun to produce usable short-form audiovisual sequences that coordinate
multiple shots, persistent subjects, performance, camera language, dialogue,
music, and sound. The unit by which progress is judged has expanded from the
frame to the clip, then to the shot, and now to the complete sequence.

This expansion changes the technical problem. Quality at the frame or clip level
can often be assessed locally, whereas usefulness at the sequence level is
compositional: constraints interact, errors accumulate over time, and decisions
in one shot affect the interpretation of the next. The system must infer a
latent creative specification from heterogeneous inputs, express it as
conditions the generator can execute, and evaluate the result at the same
semantic granularity. Multimodal understanding has evolved accordingly, from
coarse text–video correspondence to dense spatiotemporal description,
reference grounding, creative planning, and multidimensional judgment, and it
has helped make synthesis controllable and usable.

understanding of camera language, left–right relations, composition, lighting,
shot boundaries, identity binding, or dense temporal change.

model (MLLM) is broadly capable,
but which semantics reach the generator, through what representation, and with
what evidence of downstream benefit.

This perspective is grounded in our work on Kling 1.0 through Kling
4.0 [ 50 ] , together with Kling AI
Avatar [ 51 ] and Kling Motion
Control [ 52 ] . Across these releases, we specialized
Kling-MLLM, our shared multimodal foundation model, into captioners, prompt enhancement (PE)
models, text encoders, reward models, and automatic evaluators, as requirements
progressed from basic text–video correspondence to reference binding, identity
preservation, motion transfer, precise editing, audiovisual synchronization, and
complete video generation. As generation capabilities advanced,
progress depended increasingly on understanding what to generate, what to
preserve, how to organize it over time, and how to verify the result. Our
central thesis is: Video generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding
through the entire data–conditioning–alignment–evaluation chain. An observed generation failure is not, by itself, a diagnosis. The same symptom
may originate from a caption that omits the relevant supervision, a conditioning
representation that discards temporal structure, a reward model that favors
smooth but static motion, or an evaluator that never tests the requested event.
We therefore treat multimodal understanding as a property of the entire chain
rather than as a score attached to a single model. This perspective leads to
four claims: • The bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. Improvements in visual fidelity do not automatically yield correct actions,
camera language, reference binding, or narrative continuity.
Generation-oriented understanding is an independent axis of progress. • Data efficiency depends on description density. A diffusion transformer (DiT) is
trained on far fewer samples than a language model, and both training
throughput and the supply of usable video preclude closing this gap
through scaling. Each training video must therefore carry as much
supervision as possible, which makes the density of textual description
per unit of video duration the central measure of data efficiency.
Dense, generation-oriented captions and reference-grounded captions with
explicit bindings are designed to maximize this density, and a
perception-tuned text encoder ensures that it actually reaches the
generator. • A mature DiT has a sweet spot, and agentic methods help reach
it. Trained on dense captions, the generator responds best to conditions
written in its caption distribution, and a mature model can usually realize
the user’s request from a description in this distribution. Basic PE translates
requests into this distribution, but a single PE model has limited
capacity and may fail to capture the vividness of compelling videos, while asking it to
both preserve and repair a contradictory request places conflicting goals
on one model.
Agentic PE, such as story refinement that repairs contradictory requests
and retrieval of captions of compelling videos, divides this work and
improves reasonableness, faithfulness, and vividness together. • Evaluation should follow the task. Because a failure can originate anywhere in the chain, a single aggregate
score says little about its source. Generation tasks differ in their
success criteria and in the shortcuts that inflate scores, so evaluation
protocols should be task-specific and decomposed into directly observable
criteria. Inexpensive proxies, such as text-only encoder screening and
text-level PE verifiers, can filter candidates before costly end-to-end
training. Together, these practices make failures easier to trace upstream.

blocks.en: 2 Multimodal Understanding Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2 多式联运基础模型

blocks.en: 2.1 Objective and Scope
blocks.zh: 2.1 目标和范围

blocks.en:
The multimodal understanding foundation model serves as the shared perception
and reasoning backbone for Kling’s image-generation, video-generation,
image-editing, and video-editing tasks. It is not tied to a single endpoint.
Instead, the foundation checkpoints are specialized through task-specific
post-training for use as captioners, PE models, reward models,
text encoders, and other experts. This design centralizes visual, temporal,
and acoustic knowledge in a reusable base model while allowing each upstream
task to select an appropriate accuracy–latency operating point. We refer to
this model as Kling-MLLM; it unifies images, videos, audio, synchronized
audio–video, and arbitrarily interleaved media in one autoregressive
interface.

blocks.en: 2.2 Kling-MLLM Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.2 Kling-MLLM 相机 建筑

blocks.en:
The Kling-MLLM family comprises a dense 27B variant and two mixture-of-experts
(MoE) variants, 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B. Across scales and development
iterations, the large language model (LLM) and vision backbones are
initialized from compatible checkpoints in the Qwen3.5–Qwen3.8 model
families [ 39 ] .
Starting from these checkpoints, we add scale-dependent audio towers, described
in Audio below. We also redesign the modality-processing logic for images, videos, audio, synchronized
audio–video, and interleaved media, and conduct multimodal mid-training to
obtain the Kling-MLLM foundation models.

At the input interface, every supported stream is mapped to a common sequence
consumed by a single LLM (Figure 2 ). The visual path
consists of a ViT, spatial pooling, and a vision aligner. The audio path uses
a scale-dependent audio tower and projects its output to the LLM hidden width.
Consequently, the LLM can process text, visual embeddings, and acoustic
embeddings in a single sequence without quantizing the input media into a
shared discrete codebook.

Images are processed at dynamic resolution while preserving their aspect
ratios. The resolution is selected jointly with the available context budget,
allowing the model to retain useful visual detail without requiring a fixed

blocks.en:
Videos use both a dynamically selected frame rate and frame count.
The processor adapts these choices to the video’s duration and the
available context, while sampling across the full temporal range so that short
and long videos can be represented efficiently. The selected frames follow
the same dynamic-resolution path as images and are encoded into visual-token
blocks. Each block is associated with its frame’s physical timestamp, enabling the
LLM to reason about event order and temporal location without fixed sampling assumptions.

blocks.en:
Kling-MLLM uses two scale-dependent audio towers. For smaller model variants,
the tower follows the Qwen3-Omni design [ 63 ] : a 16-kHz
monaural waveform is converted to a Mel spectrogram and encoded as 13 audio
tokens per second. Larger model variants instead use a dual-branch tower that
fuses Mel and waveform-VAE features. For each clip, the data pipeline supplies
two time-aligned views: a 16-kHz, 128-bin Mel spectrogram at 100 frames per
second and a 44.1-kHz waveform for an in-house VAE. A Conv1d front end maps the
Mel stream to the target 25-token-per-second grid. In parallel, the VAE latent
sequence is linearly interpolated along the temporal axis to match the
Mel-branch token grid, then normalized and projected to the Mel hidden width.
A learned scalar gate adds these aligned VAE features residually to the Mel
features. Positional
encoding and the audio Transformer operate on the fused sequence, after which
the output projection maps it to LLM-width embeddings Z A ∈ ℝ L A × d Z_{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{L_{A}\times d} at 25 audio tokens per second. The two tower
designs therefore expose the same embedding interface to the LLM. The
processor instantiates audio-boundary, timestamp-injection, and synchronized
audio–video serialization at the selected tower’s token rate. Audio boundary
markers delimit each span, and absolute timestamps provide temporal anchors
for long audio sequences.

Audio timestamp injection. Within each audio branch, the acoustic-token rate is fixed, so elapsed time is
in principle recoverable from token position. In practice, however, this
implicit clock provides insufficient temporal control: the language model does
not always convert token indices into reliable absolute-time estimates, which
weakens duration awareness and temporal grounding. Prompting experiments with
Gemini APIs [ 11 ] support this
interpretation: explicitly providing the total audio duration in the prompt
produces a marked improvement in temporal grounding.

blocks.en:
The adopted representation places explicit start and end timestamps around
each audio span and inserts absolute-time anchors every five seconds. The
boundary timestamps expose the clip duration directly, while the periodic
anchors reduce the interval over which time must be inferred and support
fine-grained event localization. They also align the temporal organization
of audio with synchronized audio–video sequences, where acoustic and visual
tokens share a timestamped timeline.

blocks.en:
Audio and video are serialized jointly inside one synchronized multimedia
element, rather than represented as two separate media elements. Each
processed video frame forms an atomic visual-token block whose tokens share
the frame timestamp, while individual audio tokens retain timestamps
determined by the audio-token rate. The processor traverses the video frames
chronologically and, before each visual block, inserts all audio tokens that
occur after the preceding frame and no later than the current frame. Thus,
the original order within each modality is preserved, and an audio token is
placed before a visual block when they have the same timestamp. The concrete
token arrangement is illustrated in

blocks.en: 2.3 Four-Stage Training Curriculum

blocks.en:
Training follows a curriculum that broadens multimodal supervision and
progressively increases temporal coverage and context capacity.

逐步增加时间覆盖面和背景能力。

blocks.en:
The vision tower and LLM are frozen, and only the audio tower is optimized.
Training uses a short sequence length, and the data mixture consists entirely
of audio data. Its core speech component combines Mandarin, English, and
multilingual transcription data with spoken question answering,
speech-conditioned text continuation, and instruction following. Non-speech
audio coverage includes environmental and acoustic events, music, non-verbal
vocalizations, speaker and accent attributes, and detailed captioning. Data
from concatenated speech, multi-speaker dialogues, emotion-rich conversations,
audiobooks, and other long recordings provide longer acoustic contexts. Thus,
this stage establishes a broad
acoustic representation rather than an ASR-only encoder, without perturbing
the other pretrained components.

blocks.en:
All three modules are unfrozen, and training uses a short sequence length.
Audio and synchronized audio–video data constitute the largest part of the
mixture. This is the first stage in which the audio tower and LLM are
optimized jointly, so the curriculum deliberately emphasizes audio and
synchronized audio–video data to establish robust acoustic–language alignment and teach the LLM
to integrate temporally synchronized auditory and visual evidence. Audio
supervision covers multilingual ASR, spoken question answering and instruction
following, environmental sounds, music, timbre, non-verbal vocalizations,
and detailed captioning. Synchronized audio–video examples add joint
captioning, transcription, and basic temporal-event alignment.

Image, video, text, and other mixed-modality data remain in the mixture at
smaller proportions. Their role is to preserve the model’s visual
perception, language understanding, reasoning, and general multimodal capabilities while
the acoustic pathway is being integrated, thereby mitigating catastrophic
forgetting. These retained data include dense image and video captioning,
edit-instruction inference, multi-image composition, counting, OCR, document
and chart understanding, spatial reasoning, and educational and scientific
text.

All modules remain trainable, and training transitions to a long sequence
length. The mixture shifts toward audio, video, and audio–video data. Its
objective is to improve fine-grained temporal perception. The video sources
span movie and general video question answering, timestamped procedural steps,
instruction-guided temporal grounding, multi-shot narrative understanding,
spatial reasoning, unusual or anomalous action recognition, and
playback-speed-sensitive motion. Audio training continues to include
multilingual ASR, spoken instructions, sound and music captioning, and audio
question answering;
synchronized examples add timestamped audiovisual event alignment. Counting,
OCR, document and chart understanding remain in the mixture alongside
multilingual instruction, mathematical, and multi-domain reasoning data.
Additional supervision covers detailed media captioning, shot-boundary
understanding, visual artifact localization, and reference-conditioned
generation-prompt rewriting.

blocks.en:
Both modality towers are frozen and only the LLM is updated. This stage also
uses a long sequence length, allowing the model to focus on long-form
integration while retaining the frozen modality encoders.
The highest-quality data available for every supported modality are placed in
this stage, allowing the final LLM update to consolidate capabilities using
the cleanest and most reliable supervision.
Long-video data provide supervision for retrieval, question answering,
multi-span temporal grounding, reference-conditioned search,
fine-grained motion, and evidence aggregation over extended timelines.
Long-form audio receives parallel treatment through event localization,
interval-conditioned description, timestamped summarization, temporal-event
reasoning, spoken QA, and soundscape segmentation. Joint audio–visual data
emphasize synchronized description, detail recovery, cross-stream reasoning,
and constraint-following, while interleaved audio–image examples require
evidence to be composed across modalities. Visual logic, science, counting,
text recognition, document/chart understanding, and general text reasoning
remain in the mixture. The capstone stage is designed to help the LLM
organize fixed perceptual features over longer evidence chains and return
grounded, structured responses.

blocks.en:
The supervision mix is likewise adjusted by stage. Captioning is combined
with recognition, retrieval, localization, structured extraction, question
answering, and both direct-response and reasoning-oriented examples. Several
large sources are partitioned across successive stages, preserving selected
speech, OCR/document, chart, video, and reasoning coverage as new task
families are introduced. The curriculum is therefore a progression in both
modality coupling and task diversity, with increasing temporal and contextual
demands, rather than a sequence of four disjoint corpora. We also explore model merging and
find that merging the Stage 1 and Stage 4 checkpoints yields a better
checkpoint than either alone.

blocks.en:
The training corpus combines public data, Kling-specific task data, and
agent-oriented data. At the system-design level, heterogeneous
sources are represented through a common conversation-oriented schema, with
media metadata and modality boundaries retained so that one loader
can construct image, video, audio, synchronized audio–video, and interleaved
examples, following common practice in
omni-modal systems [ 63 ] .

also exclude datasets containing sensitive material, datasets whose licenses
are incompatible with the intended use, and datasets that overlap with any
evaluation set. Papers associated with the remaining candidates are routed
for review, while the selected new datasets enter automated processing.

Internal task data target the perception and reasoning capabilities required
by Kling’s image and video generation and editing systems. They cover world
knowledge through interleaved image–text records and a controlled taxonomy of
actions, sounds, subjects, and scenes; image perception through bilingual OCR
across diverse text appearances and layouts, counting, grounding,
metadata-aware description, and pose understanding; dense image and video
captioning of scenes, subjects, motion, style, camera behavior,
and multi-shot structure; and editing and reference understanding through
paired source–target images or videos, instructions for addition, deletion,
and modification, and multi-reference conditioning.

blocks.en:
The agent-data mixture spans both general-purpose tool use and multimodal
perception-to-action tasks. General-agent examples cover multi-step API and
transactional workflows, search and evidence-grounded web research,
software-engineering and terminal interaction, structured reasoning and data
transformation, and safety-aware everyday assistance. Their supervision
ranges from complete tool-use loops to partial trajectories for next-action
selection and direct responses, training the model to plan dependent actions,
interpret tool returns, verify intermediate results, and decide when tool use
is necessary. Multimodal-agent examples include image-grounded retrieval and
visual reasoning, GUI interaction grounded in screen observations, agentic
video understanding that searches and reasons over temporally distributed
evidence, and Blender-based tasks involving controllable 3D scenes, objects,
motion, camera viewpoints, and rendering. These data may be constructed or
augmented with model-generated instructions, trajectories, and responses
followed by consistency checks.

blocks.en: 3 Caption: From Pixels to Trainable Semantics
blocks.zh: 3 说明: 从像素到可训练语义

blocks.en: When training a video generator, a caption is more than a human-readable summary: it is the semantic interface that converts visual evidence into conditional supervision. Omitted details leave controllable factors underspecified, forcing the generator to fall back on dataset priors, whereas inaccurate statements inject conflicting training signals. Building a production-grade captioning system therefore requires rethinking both what information captions preserve and how they organize visual and acoustic evidence over time.
blocks.zh: 在培训视频生成器时,标题不仅仅是人可读摘要:是语义界面将视觉证据转化为有条件的监督. 公布的细节未充分说明可控制因素,迫使生成器重回数据集前科,而不准确的报表则注入相冲突的培训信号。 因此,要建立一个制作级字幕系统,就需要重新思考信息标题保存的内容以及它们如何在一段时间内组织视觉和声学证据。

blocks.en: A fluent sentence may correctly identify a scene while reversing spatial directions, collapsing sequential actions into a single state, hallucinating sounds, or losing subject identity across shots. Figure 3 shows how linguistic fluency conceals supervision errors: the caption recognizes the setting, yet mislabels a hard cut as a fade, omits the title’s timing, misses pre-appearance dialogue, and leaves visible text untranscribed. Such captions may score well on lexical-overlap metrics despite errors that compromise their value as supervision for generation.
blocks.zh: 流利的句子可以正确识别一个场景,同时颠倒空间方向,将相继动作倒入单一状态,产生幻觉的声音,或者在镜头中失去主题身份. 图3显示了语言流利如何掩盖监管错误:标题承认设置,但错误地将硬剪切标为淡出,省略了标题的时间,错过了出场前的对话,并留下了可见文本未写入. 尽管错误会损害其作为代际监督的价值,但这种标题可能会在词汇重叠度量标准上得分良好。

blocks.en: Observation Traditional captioning leaderboards and production captioning emphasize different objectives. Standard metrics reward linguistic similarity to acceptable references, while training generative models requires faithful, complete, temporally organized, and consistently formatted representations of the source video.
blocks.zh: 传统的标题和制作标题强调不同的目标。 标准衡量标准奖励语言上与可接受参考文献的相似性,而培训基因模型则需要忠实、完整、按时间排列和始终如一地对源视频进行格式化的表述。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Two captions of a 17.7 s clip from Meridian . Circled numbers link seven facts across the frames, timeline, and captions. The fluent caption reads well but omits or misrepresents key details. The generation-oriented caption preserves shot timing, audiovisual alignment, and visible text, including mirror-reversed lettering.
blocks.zh: 图3:来自Meridian的17.7分片段的两个标题。 圆形数字将七个事实连在一起,跨越了框架、时间表和标题。 流利的字幕阅读良好,但略去或误写了关键细节. 面向一代的字幕保留了拍摄时间、视听对齐和可见文本,包括反镜回转字母。

blocks.en: This gap is increasingly recognized in the research literature. Standard sentence-level metrics fail to capture hallucinations even in short image captions [ 41 ] . As captions become denser, evaluation has shifted from direct sentence matching toward decomposed multidimensional question-answer verification [ 6 ] . These efforts suggest that once captions become supervision for generation, evaluation should move from sentence-level resemblance toward verifiable semantic facts.
blocks.zh: 研究文献日益认识到这一差距。 标准句子水平的度量标准无法捕捉出幻觉,甚至在短图像标题[41]. 随着标题越来越密集,评价已从直接句子匹配转向分解的多维问答核查[6]. 这些努力表明,一旦标题成为生成的监督,评价应当从句子层面的相似性转向可核实的语义事实。

blocks.en: However, evaluation using verifiable questions risks conflating captioning capability with VQA capability. VQA tests whether a model can verify a specified detail on demand, bypassing the harder problem of deciding what to state on its own. As CAPability shows, models exhibit a “know but cannot tell” gap: strong visual recognition does not guarantee comprehensive autonomous description [ 34 ] . Consequently, strong VQA performance alone is insufficient to establish that a model can produce effective captions for training.
blocks.zh: 然而,使用可核查问题进行评价有可能将标题能力与VQA能力混为一谈。 VQA测试一个模型是否能够按要求验证一个特定的细节,绕过自行决定写什么的更难的问题. 正如能力所显示的那样,模型呈现出“知道但不能分辨”的差距:强烈的视觉识别不能保证全面的自主描述[34]。 因此,单凭强有力的VQA业绩不足以确定一个模式能够产生有效的培训说明。

blocks.en: 3.1 The Semantic Contract: Content and Conventions
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 语义合同:内容和公约

blocks.en: The content specification of a caption should be dictated by the controllable factors and failure modes of the downstream generator. Table 6 lists six types of information relevant to generation, including details that existing captioning datasets do not consistently capture.
blocks.zh: 标题的内容规格应当由下游生成器的可控制因素和故障模式决定。 表6列出了与生成有关的六类信息,包括现有标题数据集无法一致捕捉的详细信息.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Generation-oriented caption specification.
blocks.zh: 表6:面向一代的字幕规格。

blocks.en: However, rigidly enforcing this specification can be counterproductive. Subject identity, action, and temporal order are generally mandatory, while OCR, speech, sound effects, and multi-shot structure should be included only when supported by the input. Furthermore, caption granularity also depends on the downstream use case. Short captions suit retrieval, whereas dense captions provide richer supervision for generation. Mixing the two without a clear policy creates an unmanageable training distribution.
blocks.zh: 然而,僵硬地执行这一规定可能适得其反。 主题身份,动作和时间顺序一般是强制性的,而OCR,语音,音效,多镜头结构只有在有输入支持时才应当包含. 此外,标题颗粒性还取决于下游的使用情况。 短标题适用于检索,而密集标题则为生成提供了更丰富的监管. 在没有明确政策的情况下将两者混为一谈,形成了无法管理的培训分布.

blocks.en: Even when generating fluent descriptions, models frequently fail on critical dimensions, including spatial relations, camera movement, composition, lighting, and shot boundaries. While often attributed to limited capacity, these failures stem primarily from supervision gaps. Generic datasets prioritize vague aesthetic descriptors such as “cinematic lighting” and “beautiful composition” over explicit spatial and technical labels, limiting the benefits of scaling. Long videos further expose temporal failures, including reordered events, merged shots, and inconsistent references. Therefore, a video caption should not be viewed as an extended image description but rather as a compact temporal data structure.
blocks.zh: 即使生成流利的描述,模型在关键维度上也经常会出故障,包括空间关系,相机移动,组成,照明,和镜头边界等. 虽然这些失败往往归因于能力有限,但主要源于监督差距。 通用数据集将“焚化照明”和“美容成分”等模糊的美学描述词置于明确空间和技术标签之上,限制了缩放的好处。 长视频还进一步暴露出时间上的故障,包括重排事件,合并镜头,以及不一致的引用. 因此,视频字幕不应被视为扩展图像描述,而应被视为紧凑的时间数据结构。

blocks.en: While content dictates which facts enter the supervision signal, writing conventions determine whether those facts form a stable, bindable interface for the text encoder and generator. To reliably transmit these semantic details, four formatting practices yield disproportionate engineering leverage:
blocks.zh: 虽然内容决定了哪些事实进入监督信号,但书面惯例则决定这些事实是否构成文本编码器和生成器的可约束的稳定界面。 为了可靠地传递这些语义细节,四种格式化做法产生了不成比例的工程杠杆:

blocks.en: 1. Name entities explicitly and consistently. Use discriminative noun phrases and retain them across sentences and shots. Avoid ambiguous expressions such as “he”, “it”, or “the other person” when the referent may be unclear to the generator. Stable naming improves both textual coreference and visual identity continuity. 2. Treat shot timestamps as alignment signals. Anchor each shot boundary to its corresponding content using monotonic, validated timestamps. Accurate timestamp-content pairs explicitly teach the model when semantic conditions shift. 3. Transcribe visible text faithfully. Preserve original characters and salient styles instead of paraphrasing. Omitting visible text teaches the model that lettering is an uncontrolled texture, while incorrect transcription introduces contradictory supervision. 4. Integrate audio with visual elements temporally. Describe dialogue, salient sound effects, and music at the points where they occur within the visual narrative. Crucially, audio-related fields should be activated only when an audio track has been inspected.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 明确和一致地点名实体。 使用歧视性名词短语并保留到句子和镜头之间. 避免“他”、“他”或“另一人”等模棱两可的用词,因为生成人可能不清楚。 平稳的命名既能改善文字的共通关系,又能改善视觉特征的连续性. 2. 将射出的时间戳作为对齐信号。 Anchor使用被验证的单调时间戳将边界射出相应的内容。 准确的时间戳-内容对在语义条件变化时明确教导模型. 3. 忠实地翻译可见文本。 保留原作的人物和突出的风格,而不要作旁白. 发音可见的文字教导模型,发音是一种不受控制的纹理,而不正确的抄录则引入了自相矛盾的监督. 4. 暂时将音频与视觉要素结合起来。 在视觉叙事中描述对话、显著的音效和音乐发生点。 关键是,只有在检查了音频音轨之后,才应启动与音频有关的字段。

blocks.en: 3.2 The Supervision Pipeline: Separating Complex Discovery from Efficient Deployment
blocks.zh: 3.2 监督管道:将复杂发现与高效部署分开

blocks.en: Satisfying this semantic contract at production scale is beyond what a single prompt to a proprietary model can deliver. Constructing reliable supervision requires a multi-stage pipeline:
blocks.zh: 满足这个生产规模的语义合同,超出了一个单一的即时到专有模型所能提供的范围. 建立可靠的监督需要多阶段管道:

blocks.en: 1. Inspection and Routing: Videos are classified by content type, duration, motion dynamics, shot density, and audio availability to determine the necessary expert pathways. 2. Perceptual Evidence Preservation: Preprocessing steps such as downsampling, black-frame removal, audio decoding, and OCR/ASR ensure that critical signals remain intact before reaching expert models. 3. Routed Expert Claims: A general visual expert identifies subjects and scene content, while specialized models extract specific dimensions, such as camera motion, spatial relations, lighting, and shot boundaries. 4. Integration and Conflict Resolution: The integration layer resolves conflicting expert claims against source evidence, normalizes terminology, assigns stable entity names, and removes redundancy. 5. Conjunctive Quality Gating: Candidates should strictly satisfy thresholds across accuracy, coverage, and diversity, alongside cross-modal and cross-shot consistency checks. Rejected cases flow into a difficulty-indexed error pool for diagnosis and targeted remediation.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 检查与游走:视频按内容类型,持续时间,运动动态,镜头密度,音频可用性分类,以确定必要的专家路径. 2. 概念证据保存: 预处理步骤,如下取样、去除黑框、音频解码和OCR/ASR,确保关键信号在到达专家模型之前保持不变。 3. 路线专家索赔: 一般视觉专家确定主题和场景内容,而专业模型则提取出特定的维度,如相机运动,空间关系,照明,和镜头边界等. 4. 一体化和解决冲突: 集成层解决了与源证据相冲突的专家诉求,使术语正常化,指定了稳定的实体名称,并去除冗余. 5. 连通性质量衡量:候选人应严格遵守跨准确性、覆盖面和多样性的阈值,同时进行跨模式和跨镜头一致性检查。 拒绝的病例流入一个有困难索引的误差池,用于诊断和有针对性的补救。

blocks.en: Inspection and Routing: Videos are classified by content type, duration, motion dynamics, shot density, and audio availability to determine the necessary expert pathways.
blocks.zh: 检查和排队: 视频按内容类型,持续时间,运动动态,镜头密度,音频可用性分类,以确定必要的专家路径.

blocks.en: Perceptual Evidence Preservation: Preprocessing steps such as downsampling, black-frame removal, audio decoding, and OCR/ASR ensure that critical signals remain intact before reaching expert models.
blocks.zh: 概念证据保存: 预处理步骤,如下取样、去除黑框、音频解码和OCR/ASR,确保关键信号在到达专家模型之前保持不变。

blocks.en: Routed Expert Claims: A general visual expert identifies subjects and scene content, while specialized models extract specific dimensions, such as camera motion, spatial relations, lighting, and shot boundaries.
blocks.zh: 路线专家索赔: 一般视觉专家确定主题和场景内容,而专业模型则提取出特定的维度,如相机运动,空间关系,照明,和镜头边界等.

blocks.en: Integration and Conflict Resolution: The integration layer resolves conflicting expert claims against source evidence, normalizes terminology, assigns stable entity names, and removes redundancy.
blocks.zh: 一体化和解决冲突: 集成层解决了与源证据相冲突的专家诉求,使术语正常化,指定了稳定的实体名称,并去除冗余.

blocks.en: Conjunctive Quality Gating: Candidates should strictly satisfy thresholds across accuracy, coverage, and diversity, alongside cross-modal and cross-shot consistency checks. Rejected cases flow into a difficulty-indexed error pool for diagnosis and targeted remediation.
blocks.zh: 相接质量 衡量:候选人在进行跨模式和跨镜头一致性检查的同时,应严格遵守准确性、覆盖面和多样性的阈值。 拒绝的病例流入一个有困难索引的误差池,用于诊断和有针对性的补救。

blocks.en: Insight Robust supervision originates from orchestrated pipelines. Explicitly mining previously unobserved dimensions and resolving inter-expert conflicts expand semantic coverage and accuracy far more effectively than simply scaling up a general-purpose annotator.
blocks.zh: 深视强力监控来自精心设计的管道. 明确挖掘以前未观察到的层面并解决专家间冲突,比仅仅扩大一般目的说明人的范围要有效得多地扩大语义范围和准确性。

blocks.en: Although this multi-expert pipeline produces comprehensive and reliable supervision, deploying it directly incurs prohibitive latency because of its serial execution. To address this limitation, the pipeline’s output should be distilled into a single-pass student model. This reduces the deployment footprint while preserving globally consistent entity naming and the semantic contract synthesized by the offline factory.
blocks.zh: 尽管这一多专家管道产生了全面和可靠的监督,但由于其连续执行,其部署直接造成令人无法忍受的延迟。 为解决这一限制,管道的输出应被蒸馏成一个单通学生模型。 这减少了部署足迹,同时保留了全球一致的实体命名和离线工厂合成的语义合同.

blocks.en: 3.3 Acceptance Criteria: Conjunctive Quality and Atomic Benchmarking
blocks.zh: 3.3 接受标准:共同的质量和原子基准

blocks.en: A production-grade caption should satisfy four criteria simultaneously: factual accuracy, semantic coverage, beneficial diversity, and internal consistency. These four criteria are strictly conjunctive: optimizing any single dimension in isolation induces predictable shortcuts and specific generation failures, as illustrated in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 生产级标题应同时满足四项标准:事实准确性、语义涵盖、有益的多样性和内部一致性。 如表7所示,这四项标准是严格结合的:在孤立状态下优化任何单一维度会导致可预见的捷径和特定的生成失败。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Shortcuts from optimizing each caption criterion in isolation.
blocks.zh: 表7:孤立地优化每个标题标准的快捷键。

blocks.en: To prevent these shortcuts, evaluation should move beyond lexical metrics and test these criteria directly. As CHAIR demonstrates, higher sentence-level scores do not imply fewer hallucinations [ 41 ] . This vulnerability is especially pronounced in dense captions, where local errors are easily diluted by surrounding fluent text.
blocks.zh: 为防止出现这些捷径,评价应超越词汇标准,直接测试这些标准。 正如主席所证明的,较高刑期的分数并不意味着幻觉减少[41]. 这种脆弱性在密集的标题中特别明显,当地的错误很容易被周围流利的文字所淡化.

blocks.en: Therefore, the appropriate evaluation unit is an atomic, source-grounded information item. Instead of matching surface text, evaluators should verify whether a candidate caption correctly expresses predefined essential facts and their temporal scopes. This atomic formulation is largely agnostic to surface phrasing, effectively disentangling the four acceptance criteria that reference-based metrics tend to conflate.
blocks.zh: 因此,适当的评价单位是原子、来源信息项目。 评价人员应核实候选标题是否正确表达预先确定的基本事实及其时间范围,而不是与表面文本相匹配。 这种原子配体基本上不可知地对地表的用词,有效地剥离了基于参考的测量法倾向于混入的四种接受标准.

blocks.en: A comprehensive benchmark should expose at least four complementary views: • Content validity: factual precision, semantic coverage, beneficial diversity, and internal consistency; • Generation-specific dimensions: action progression, spatial direction, cinematography, composition, lighting, temporal ordering, shot transitions, OCR, speech, and sound; • Interface compliance: parse rate, timestamp validity, terminology compliance, and marker validity; • Difficulty slices: duration, shot count, entity count, event count, motion speed, OCR density, audio complexity, and content domain.
blocks.zh: 综合基准应至少暴露出四种补充观点:内容有效性:事实精确性、语义覆盖性、有益多样性和内部一致性;特定世代的维度:动作进展、空间方向、电影、组成、照明、时令、镜头过渡、OCR、语音和声音;接口合规性:解析率、时间戳有效性、术语合规性和标记有效性;难度:持续时间、镜头计数、实体计数、事件计数、运动速度、OCR密度、音频复杂性和内容域。

blocks.en: Content validity: factual precision, semantic coverage, beneficial diversity, and internal consistency;
blocks.zh: 内容有效性:事实准确性、语义涵盖范围、有益的多样性和内部一致性;

blocks.en: Generation-specific dimensions: action progression, spatial direction, cinematography, composition, lighting, temporal ordering, shot transitions, OCR, speech, and sound;
blocks.zh: 特定世代的维度:动作进展、空间方向、电影摄影、组成、照明、时序、镜头过渡、OCR、语音和声音;

blocks.en: Interface compliance: parse rate, timestamp validity, terminology compliance, and marker validity;
blocks.zh: 界面合规性:解析率、时间戳有效性、术语合规性和标记有效性;

blocks.en: Difficulty slices: duration, shot count, entity count, event count, motion speed, OCR density, audio complexity, and content domain.
blocks.zh: 难度切片:持续时间,镜头计数,实体计数,事件计数,运动速度,OCR密度,音频复杂度,以及内容域.

blocks.en: Finally, automatic judges require rigorous stability validation prior to deployment. This entails measuring judgment variance on identical captions, calibrating against human annotations on stratified subsets, and checking ranking robustness across different model families. Crucially, evaluation should control for caption length to prevent judges from conflating verbosity with true semantic coverage. More broadly, the judge model, evaluation prompt, decoding parameters, and preprocessing steps together define the benchmark configuration and should therefore be versioned as part of the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 最后,自动法官在部署之前需要严格的稳定验证。 这需要衡量对相同标题的判断差异,对照分层子集的人类说明校正,并检查不同模式家庭的排名稳健度。 关键的是,评价应控制标题长度,以防止法官将动词与真正的语义覆盖混为一谈。 更广泛地说,法官模型、评价即时、解码参数和预处理步骤共同界定了基准配置,因此,应作为评价协议的一部分加以修改。

blocks.en: Insight True superiority withstands granular decomposition. A credible improvement specifies which facts are more accurate, which dimensions are more complete, and under which difficulty slices the improvements persist. Gains that vanish when controlling for caption length or appear only in aggregate scores provide insufficient evidence of better supervisory quality.
blocks.zh: 透视特有优势能承受颗粒分解. 可信的改进规定哪些事实更准确,哪些方面更完整,在哪些困难下,改进将持续下去。 在控制标题长度时消失或只出现在总分中的收益不足以证明监督质量提高。

blocks.en: 3.4 Downstream Validation: The Generator as the Final Consumer
blocks.zh: 3.4 下游验证: 作为最后消费者的发电机

blocks.en: Intrinsic caption evaluations function as proxies until validated by a downstream consumer. Recent benchmarks such as VidCapBench [ 6 ] and CapRiCorn-1K [ 5 ] demonstrate strong correlations between their evaluation scores and downstream performance, including text-to-video generation quality and video reconstruction fidelity, thereby establishing a core experimental principle: caption quality should ultimately be judged by the generative capabilities it enables in the downstream model.
blocks.zh: 内向标题评价起到代理作用,直到下游消费者验证为止。 近期的基准,如VidCap Bench [6]和CapRiCorn-1K [5],显示其评价分数与下游业绩之间有很强的关联性,包括文本到视频生成质量和视频重建忠心度,从而确立了核心实验原则:标题质量最终应当由它在下游模型中实现的基因能力来判断.

blocks.en: Observation Descriptive quality does not automatically translate into supervisory quality. A caption may become more readable while exceeding the text encoder’s effective context, adding details that the generator cannot localize in time, or inflating evaluation scores via generic aesthetic terms. Downstream validation is essential to distinguish superficial linguistic improvement from usable conditional information.
blocks.zh: 说明性质量不会自动转化为监督性质量。 一个标题在超过文本编码器的有效上下文时可能变得更加可读取,并添加生成器无法及时定位的细节,或者通过通用美学术语来夸大评价分数. 下游验证对于将表面语言改进与可用有条件信息区分开来至关重要.

blocks.en: Controlled downstream experiments help distinguish usable conditional information from superficial linguistic gains. Matching caption lengths and verified fact counts can reduce confounding effects, while targeted interventions, such as modifying camera-motion descriptions alone, can reveal whether improvements transfer to the corresponding generation capability. Combining human preferences with fine-grained metrics—spanning subject identity, action, space, camera, temporal structure, text rendering, audio alignment, and visual quality—exposes specific control failures that a global text–video similarity score obscures.
blocks.zh: 受控制的下游实验有助于区分可用的有条件信息与表面语言学增益. 匹配标题长度和已核实的事实计数可以减少混淆效果,而有针对性的干预,如仅修改相机-运动描述,就可以揭示改进是否转移到相应的生成能力. 将人类偏好与精细的度量标准结合起来——拓宽主题特征、动作、空间、相机、时间结构、文本渲染、音频对齐和视觉质量——暴露出具体的控制故障,全球文本-视频相似性得分模糊。

blocks.en: Ultimately, the value of a captioning strategy lies in its measurable effect on generation. Small-scale fine-tuning or evaluation with a frozen generator provides a practical way to assess whether improved captions yield more faithful instruction following before changes are scaled to larger training pipelines.
blocks.zh: 最终,标题战略的价值在于其对生成的可衡量影响。 用冷冻发电机进行小规模的微调或评价,为评估改进后的标题是否在变化扩大为更大的培训管道之前产生更忠实的指导提供了一个实际的方法。

blocks.en: 3.5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.5 实验

blocks.en: Building on Kling-MLLM-35B-A3B and Kling-MLLM-397B-A17B, we construct targeted post-training data guided by the insights in this section to obtain Kling-Captioner. Table 8 compares Kling-Captioner with frontier models on VidCapBench [ 6 ] , UGC-VideoCap [ 62 ] , and our internal benchmark. The results show that Kling-Captioner consistently outperforms the baselines across all three benchmarks, achieving the best overall accuracy, precision, and coverage on VidCapBench while leading in every dimension on UGC-VideoCap and across our internal evaluation targets for motion, camera, and sound.
blocks.zh: 在克林-MLM-35B-A3B和克林-MLM-397B-A17B的基础上,我们根据本节的见解,构建有针对性的培训后数据,以获得克林-Captioner. 表8将Kling-Captioner与VidCap Bench [6]、UGC-VideoCap [62] 和我们的内部基准的前沿模型进行比较。 结果显示,Kling-Captioner在所有三个基准中都持续超过基线,在VidCap Bench上实现最佳的总体准确性、精确性和覆盖,同时在UGC-VideoCap的每个维度以及我们内部对运动、相机和声音的评价指标中占据领先地位。

blocks.en: 3.6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.6 讨论情况

blocks.en: Scaling the captioning system described in this section leaves several open challenges for future research. First, accurately capturing highly dynamic details necessitates balancing temporal and spatial fidelity against limited context capacity. Second, long-form videos demand sophisticated strategies to navigate the trade-off between overall caption length and descriptive density while maintaining robust referential consistency for subjects over extended time horizons. Finally, stronger audiovisual integration is needed to accurately align acoustic and visual events and explicitly associate speakers with their utterances.
blocks.zh: 扩大本节所描述的标题系统,为今后的研究留下了几个公开的挑战。 首先,要准确掌握动态强的细节,就必须平衡时间和空间的忠诚度与有限的上下文能力。 第二,长式录像需要周密的战略,以在总体标题长度和描述密度之间实现取舍,同时在较长的时间内保持对主题的强有力的优惠一致性。 最后,有必要加强视听一体化,以便准确调整声响和视觉活动,明确将发言者与其言论联系起来。

blocks.en: The framework developed in this section focuses on absolute video descriptions, detailing the objective content of a target video. Reference-conditioned generation, however, introduces new operational constraints: the caption should additionally specify reference bindings, isolate preserved attributes, and describe relative transformations while maintaining compatibility with the existing textual conditioning interface. The engineering principles governing this relative semantic contract are discussed in the next section.
blocks.zh: 本节制定的框架以绝对视频描述为主,详述了目标视频的客观内容. 然而,有参考条件的生成引入了新的操作限制:标题应该额外指定参考约束,隔离所保存的属性,并描述相对的转换,同时保持与现有文字调节接口相容. 这一相对语义合同的工程原则在下一节讨论。

blocks.en: 4 Reference-Grounded Captioning: Orchestrating Coherent Multimodal Anchors
blocks.zh: 4 参照组合式说明:管弦接合式多式管弦

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Reference-grounded captioning on a 22.5 s clip from Meridian , given two portraits (IMG_1, IMG_2) and a voice track (AUD_1). The caption states each binding with its scope and writes out everything the references cannot supply. The timeline shows who is on screen and when PERSON_1 speaks. Circled numbers mark where each property of the semantic contract applies, contrasting typical shortcuts with correct formulations.
blocks.zh: 图4:从Meridian的22.5 s的剪辑上, 提供了两幅肖像画(IMG_1, IMG_2)和一个语音轨迹(AUD_1)。 标题说明每个标题都附有其范围,并写出无法提供的参考资料。 时间表显示谁在屏幕上,以及Person_1何时发言. 圆形数字标出语义合同的每个属性适用的地方,将典型的快捷键与正确的配方作对比.

blocks.en: Reference-conditioned generation enables controllable video creation through multimodal references, such as character portraits, source clips, and voice tracks. However, introducing reference conditions creates a demanding correspondence problem. Each reference requires explicit binding to the correct target entity, property, modality, and temporal interval. Without precise alignment, a generated video may appear perceptually flawless while suffering from critical systemic failures, such as exchanged identities, leaked attributes, edited protected content, or broken state continuity.
blocks.zh: 具有参考条件的生成能够通过多种模式的参考,例如人物肖像、源片段和语音轨迹,实现可控制的视频创建。 然而,引入参考条件造成了要求很高的函证问题. 每次提及都需要对正确的目标实体、财产、方式和时间间隔明确具有约束力。 没有精确的校正,生成的视频可能会在视觉上无瑕疵地出现,同时会遭受严重的系统故障,如交换身份,泄露属性,编辑后受保护的内容,或者断裂状态连续性等.

blocks.en: Reference-grounded captioning (RGC) describes target videos conditioned on one or more multimodal references. Extending the semantic interface from Section 3 , RGC explicitly specifies reference-target bindings, modified properties, and supplemental target facts. At training scale, simply pairing references with conventional captions leaves these relationships implicit, causing the generator to learn global appearance correlations without reliable entity-level control. RGC resolves this problem by making the intended correspondences explicit, thereby providing robust supervision for both reference fidelity and controlled modification. Figure 4 illustrates RGC on a multi-shot clip conditioned on two character portraits and a voice track.
blocks.zh: 以参考为基础的标题(RGC)描述了以一种或多种多式参考为条件的目标视频。 扩展第3节的语义界面,RGC明确规定了参考目标绑定,修改后属性,以及补充目标事实. 在训练规模上,简单地将参考文献与常规标题配对,就使得这些关系隐含了下来,使得生成者学会了全球外观相关性,而没有可靠的实体级控制. 王国政府通过明确拟发的函文解决这一问题,从而对参考忠诚和有控制的修改提供有力的监督。 图4显示了RGC在以两个人物肖像和语音轨迹为条件的多镜头剪辑.

blocks.en: 4.1 Task Definition: Reference Semantics and Systemic Challenges
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务定义:参考语义和系统挑战

blocks.en: Rather than generating an unconstrained summary from a target video, reference assets, and task instructions, RGC defines the resulting caption as an integration of three distinct components: explicit pointers linking reference assets to target entities, supplementary descriptions capturing unreferenced facts, and scoped preservation or change records preventing text-reference conflicts.
blocks.zh: 英国广播公司不是从目标视频、参考资产和任务指示中生成不受限制的摘要,而是将由此产生的标题定义为三个不同组成部分的整合:将参考资产与目标实体联系起来的明确指针、收集未参考事实的补充说明以及防止文本参考冲突的范围保存或更改记录。

blocks.en: Crucially, RGC requires determining the scope of each reference’s authority, which is asymmetric across properties. For instance, a portrait may dictate facial identity while leaving body pose free; a source video may lock background geometry while licensing a requested localized edit; and an audio clip may define voice or rhythm without dictating visual action. Table 9 outlines how superficially similar inputs carry divergent semantic authority based on the product task.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,王国政府要求确定每个参考机构的权限范围,这在各个属性之间是不对称的。 例如,肖像片在离开身体时可能支配面部特征;源视频可能锁定背景几何,同时许可请求的本地化编辑;音频剪辑片段可能定义语音或节奏而无需描述视觉动作. 表9概述了表面相似的投入如何根据产品任务具有不同的语义权威。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Product tasks covered by RGC.
blocks.zh: 表9:王国政府负责的产品任务。

blocks.en: RGC inherits all requirements of standard captioning while introducing four additional challenges: • Reference-target confusion: Populating a scene with multiple entities introduces severe combinatorial assignment ambiguity, especially when the references are semantically similar. • Asymmetric modality authority: Different modalities naturally govern distinct properties (e.g., pixels for appearance, audio for timbre, video for motion), yet explicit instructions can selectively override these priors, requiring dynamic conflict resolution at the granular level of entities, attributes, and temporal intervals. • Temporal binding persistence: Maintaining consistent identity associations across time is inherently fragile. Models should track and bind entities through severe visual and temporal disruptions, such as occlusions, abrupt cuts, and drastic viewpoint changes. • Degenerate shortcuts: Models can artificially inflate precision by omitting entity IDs, using vague phrasing, or skipping complex edits entirely. Although factually safe, these shortcuts starve the generator of essential supervision, necessitating strict evaluation of required coverage alongside correctness.
blocks.zh: • 参考-目标混淆: 将一个场景与多个实体混为一谈,引入了严重的组合指派模糊性,特别是当参考文献具有相似性时。 • 不对称方式授权: 不同的模式自然会支配不同的属性(例如外观像素,发音为timbre,相机为timbre),但明确的指令可以有选择地覆盖这些前缀,需要在实体的颗粒级,属性和时间间隔上动态地解决冲突. · 具有临时约束力的持久性:在一段时间内保持连贯一致的身份联系本身就很脆弱。 模型应该通过严重的视觉和时间干扰,如隔离、突然削减和急剧的视角变化来跟踪和约束实体。 • 减速捷径: 模型可以通过省略实体ID来人为地提高精度,使用模糊的用词,或者完全跳过复杂的编辑. 这些捷径虽然在事实上是安全的,但却使产生基本监督的人挨饿,因此必须严格评估必要的覆盖面,同时做到正确。

blocks.en: Reference-target confusion: Populating a scene with multiple entities introduces severe combinatorial assignment ambiguity, especially when the references are semantically similar.
blocks.zh: 参考目标混淆: 将一个场景与多个实体混为一谈,引入了严重的组合指派模糊性,特别是当参考文献具有相似性时。

blocks.en: Asymmetric modality authority: Different modalities naturally govern distinct properties (e.g., pixels for appearance, audio for timbre, video for motion), yet explicit instructions can selectively override these priors, requiring dynamic conflict resolution at the granular level of entities, attributes, and temporal intervals.
blocks.zh: 非对称方式授权 : 不同的模式自然会支配不同的属性(例如外观像素,发音为timbre,相机为timbre),但明确的指令可以有选择地覆盖这些前缀,需要在实体的颗粒级,属性和时间间隔上动态地解决冲突.

blocks.en: Temporal binding persistence: Maintaining consistent identity associations across time is inherently fragile. Models should track and bind entities through severe visual and temporal disruptions, such as occlusions, abrupt cuts, and drastic viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 具有临时约束力的持久性:在一段时间内保持一致性的认同关系本来就是脆弱的。 模型应该通过严重的视觉和时间干扰,如隔离、突然削减和急剧的视角变化来跟踪和约束实体。

blocks.en: Degenerate shortcuts: Models can artificially inflate precision by omitting entity IDs, using vague phrasing, or skipping complex edits entirely. Although factually safe, these shortcuts starve the generator of essential supervision, necessitating strict evaluation of required coverage alongside correctness.
blocks.zh: 退位快捷键 : 模型可以通过省略实体ID来人为地提高精度,使用模糊的用词,或者完全跳过复杂的编辑. 这些捷径虽然在事实上是安全的,但却使产生基本监督的人挨饿,因此必须严格评估必要的覆盖面,同时做到正确。

blocks.en: Observation Difficulty is governed by reference separability and complex attribute binding, not by reference count alone. Similar subjects increase assignment ambiguity, while capturing localized state changes requires isolating relevant properties from a vast set of contextual invariants.
blocks.zh: 困难在于参考分离性和复杂的属性约束,而不只是参考数。 类似的主体会增加任务模糊性,同时要捕捉本地化的状态变化,就需要将相关属性与一大批背景变化相隔离.

blocks.en: 4.2 The Semantic Contract: Scoped Binding, Residual Sufficiency, and Authority Consistency
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 语义合同:范围约束、剩余充足性和权威一致性

blocks.en: Reliable RGC supervision relies on three conjunctive properties: scoped binding, residual sufficiency, and authority consistency. Table 10 summarizes their roles and illustrates how violating any single axis compromises the reliability of the resulting supervision signal.
blocks.zh: 可靠的皇家卫队监督取决于三个连通性:范围约束、剩余充足性和权威一致性。 表10总结了他们的作用,并说明了违反任何单一轴线如何损害由此产生的监督信号的可靠性。

blocks.en: Table 10 : The semantic contract of RGC.
blocks.zh: 表10:皇家海军的语义合同。

blocks.en: These requirements extend the four caption criteria introduced in Section 3.3 . Factual accuracy now mandates rigorous binding verification alongside factual correctness. Semantic coverage expands to encompass standard target facts, required references, and residual target specifications. Beneficial diversity primarily applies to the target description, while pointer syntax and entity naming should remain deliberately stable. Internal consistency requires strict alignment among the caption, references, and the target.
blocks.zh: 这些要求扩大了第3.3节提出的四个标题标准。 事实准确性现在要求严格进行具有约束力的核查,同时进行事实正确性核查。 语义学的涵盖范围已扩大到包括标准目标事实、所需参考文献和剩余目标规格。 受益多样性主要适用于目标描述,而指针语法和实体命名应保持有意稳定. 内部一致性要求标题、参考文献和目标严格一致。

blocks.en: Scoped Binding. A valid binding specifies the source evidence, target entity, authorized attribute, and temporal scope. The instruction “Use image 2” is incomplete when the image contains a person, a specific garment, a room, and a photographic style. A sufficient binding should instead specify, for example, that “ PERSON_1 takes its identity and outfit from IMG_2 ; the background is not referenced.” Persistent identifiers are thus essential, as bare noun phrases cannot reliably anchor identities when multiple entities recur.
blocks.zh: 范围约束。 有效的约束规定了来源证据、目标实体、授权属性和时间范围。 “使用图像2”指示不完整,因为图像包含一个人、特定服装、房间和相片样式。 例如,充分的约束力应规定,“个人1号从IMG_2中取出其身份和装束;背景不作参考。” 因此,持续的识别特征至关重要,因为当多个实体再次出现时,赤裸裸的名词短语无法可靠地锁定身份。

blocks.en: Residual Sufficiency. While an RGC caption need not reproduce the entire target description, it should specify every generation-relevant fact that cannot be recovered from authorized references. For character portraits, the caption usually includes action, interaction, camera behavior, timing, scene placement, and sound. For continuation, it details the post-prefix event and the state transition at the temporal boundary. For editing, it includes the edited attribute, region, and temporal interval, along with any intended cross-modal consequence.
blocks.zh: 余所摄受. 虽然RGC标题不需要复制整个目标描述,但应当具体说明不能从授权的参考文献中取回的每一代相关事实。 对于人物肖像,标题通常包括动作,互动,相机行为,时间,场景布置,和声音. 为了继续,它详细介绍了后前缀事件和时间边界的状态过渡. 对于编辑,它包括经编辑的属性、区域和时间间隔,以及任何预期的跨模式后果。

blocks.en: Authority Consistency. Once an attribute is delegated to a reference, the caption should not independently assign it an incompatible value. Re-describing intricate facial geometry, voice timbre, or complex motion in text is inherently lossy and may also introduce competing conditions. To enforce authority consistency, the caption should defer to the authorized reference for governed properties, except where an override is explicitly declared together with its scope. By otherwise restricting itself to the necessary residual facts, the caption avoids silent cross-modal overrides.
blocks.zh: 权威一致性. 一旦一个属性被下放到一个参考物中,标题不应该独立地给它指定一个不相容的值. 重新描述复杂的面部几何,语音平缓,或文字中的复杂运动,本质上是失去的,也可能引入相竞条件. 为了保证权威的一致性,标题应服从对所管辖财产的授权参考,除非明确宣布了推翻及其范围。 否则,标题仅限于必要的剩余事实,从而避免了沉默的交叉方式。

blocks.en: Insight The semantic contract transforms the caption into an active control schematic. Scoped binding delegates authority to the reference evidence, residual sufficiency fills the contextual gaps, and authority consistency prevents cross-modal interference, delivering a coherent and unambiguous instruction set to the generator.
blocks.zh: 透视 语义合同将标题转换为活性控制图. 具有广泛约束力的委托人有权查阅参考证据,剩余充足性填补了背景空白,权威一致性防止跨模式干扰,向生成人提供一套连贯而明确的指示。

blocks.en: 4.4 Unified Representation: Integrating Captions with Reference Pointers
blocks.zh: 4.4 统一代表制: 将标题与参考指针结合

blocks.en: Reference-grounded tasks inherit the structure, terminology, and descriptive granularity of standard captions and augment them with stable reference pointers and explicit change scopes. This unified representation allows standard and reference-grounded data to share the same captioner, text encoder, PE policy, and validators, with standard captioning treated as a zero-reference case. The generator therefore preserves a consistent target organization regardless of whether details are expressed literally or supplied through reference pointers. As a result, large-scale standard-caption data can provide broad semantic supervision, while scarcer multi-reference data focuses on learning reference binding and controlled modification.
blocks.zh: 以参考为依据的任务继承了标准标题的结构、术语和描述性颗粒性,并增加了稳定的参考指针和明确的改变范围。 这种统一的表示式使得标准数据和以引用为基础的数据可以共享相同的标题,文本编码器,PE政策和验证器,标准标题作为零引用例处理. 因此,无论细节是按字面表达还是通过参考指针提供,生成器都保留了一致的目标组织. 因此,大规模标准封装数据可以提供广泛的语义监督,而稀有多参考数据则侧重于学习引用绑定和有控制的修改.

blocks.en: Insight Representation consistency enables compositional supervision. A unified representation allows the model to combine broad semantic coverage learned from large-scale standard captions with the reference-binding logic derived from scarcer multi-reference data.
blocks.zh: 洞察代表性的一致性使组成监督成为可能。 统一表述使模型能够将从大规模标准标题中吸取的广义语义覆盖与从稀有多参考数据中得出的有参考约束力的逻辑结合起来.

blocks.en: Different reference modalities contribute distinct information and introduce unique ambiguities. Table 11 summarizes the typical authority, main ambiguity, and corresponding caption-side response for each modality.
blocks.zh: 不同的参考模式提供了不同的信息,并产生了独特的模糊之处。 表11概述了每种方式的典型权威、主要模糊性以及相应的标题-侧响应。

blocks.en: Table 11 : Authority and ambiguity of each reference modality.
blocks.zh: 表11:每种参考方式的权力和模糊性。

blocks.en: Specifically, image references risk identity swaps and attribute leakage, demanding bindings that distinguish identity, pose, and style while defining the precise transfer scope for each attribute. Video references introduce role and temporal ambiguity. Since a source video may dictate content, motion, editing, or camera behavior, captions require explicit role bindings and temporal scopes that withstand shifts in speed, viewpoint, or duration. Audio references trigger source-assignment ambiguity, necessitating independent speaker and event scopes. Text instructions encode intended transformations rather than the actual state of the target, meaning captions must verify execution outcomes to differentiate intent from observed reality.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,图像参考风险身份交换和属性泄漏,要求绑定区分身份,姿势,风格,同时定义每个属性的精确转移范围. 视频参考引入了角色和时间模糊. 由于源视频可能支配内容、运动、编辑或相机行为,字幕需要明确的角色约束和时间范围,以承受速度、观点或持续时间的变化。 音频参考引发来源分配模糊,需要独立演讲人和活动范围。 文本指令编码了预期的转换而不是目标的实际状态,意思是标题必须验证执行结果,以区别意图与所观察到的现实.

blocks.en: Together, these modality-specific requirements converge on a hybrid representation featuring (1) a compact reference registry with stable IDs, modalities, roles, and permitted scopes; (2) a foundational target-video description utilizing registered IDs; (3) explicit preservation and modification records for editing and continuation; and (4) shot or event timestamps that connect bindings to applicable intervals.
blocks.zh: 这些模式特定要求合在一起,以混合代表为主:(1) 具有稳定ID、模式、作用和允许范围的紧凑参考登记册;(2) 使用已登记的ID的基础目标视频描述;(3) 明确保存和修改记录,以供编辑和继续;和(4) 将约束与适用间隔联系起来的拍摄或事件时间戳。

blocks.en: 4.5 The Supervision Pipeline: Extending for Cross-Modal Correspondences
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 监督管道:延长跨分期通信

blocks.en:
Generating RGC data at scale requires extending the multi-expert design in
Section 3.2 to include dedicated stages for cross-modal reference parsing, rigorous correspondence checking, and systematic conflict resolution.
blocks.zh:
大规模生成 RGC 数据需要扩展多专家设计
第3.2节包括跨模式参考解析、严格通信检查和系统解决冲突的专门阶段。

blocks.en: 1. Type the task and references. Identify whether each input supplies identity, appearance, motion, camera, voice, style, or instruction. Record its modality, quality, temporal extent, and permissible transfer scope. 2. Describe target and references independently. Preserve a standard target description to maintain target-side coverage. In parallel, extract entities, attributes, actions, shots, audio events, and specialist evidence from each reference without prematurely assuming correspondences. 3. Propose and verify bindings. Use detection, segmentation, tracking, OCR or ASR, motion features, and MLLM reasoning to generate and jointly verify candidate matches across viewpoints and over time. 4. Determine preservation and residual sufficiency. Compare target and source under the declared task. Explicitly distinguish requested changes, preserved properties, incidental changes, and unresolved evidence. 5. Resolve authority and conflicts. Construct an entity-attribute-time map in which each cell identifies the authoritative input. Adjudicate mutually inconsistent expert claims before prose generation. 6. Write once in the common format. Insert scoped pointers, retain standard target facts not supplied by references, and remove only verified redundancy. A single integrated target description is preferable to serial rewrites that repeatedly rename or rebind entities. 7. Apply deterministic and semantic gates. Check pointer validity, binding coverage, forbidden cross-scope transfer, text-reference conflicts, temporal alignment, and the four standard captioning criteria.

blocks.zh: 4.6 实验

blocks.en: Following the relational supervision pipeline and unified pointer representation introduced in this section, we further post-train Kling-Captioner on curated cross-modal correspondence data to obtain Kling-RGC. Table 12 compares Kling-RGC with frontier models on ViDiC [ 60 ] and MRVBench [ 29 ] . Kling-RGC leads across all ViDiC metrics in both difference and similarity captioning; on MRVBench, it achieves the highest keypoint coverage, VQA accuracy, and reference-binding precision while remaining highly competitive with Gemini-4-Argon and substantially outperforming Doubao2.1-Lite across the remaining metrics.

blocks.en: 4.7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Future work could increase the flexibility of reference content and composition. Key directions include supporting diverse input forms (e.g., selected regions, sketches, and trajectories), enabling complex multimodal combinations to jointly specify a single target, and developing finer-grained temporal binding for precise synchronization and transitions. Advancing these areas requires targeted supervision and evaluation.

blocks.en: In real-world inference, user requests typically offer references and brief instructions without specifying the complete binding structure or scope of each reference. The remaining challenge is therefore to translate these underspecified requests into the same scoped, residual-sufficient, and authority-consistent caption distribution used during training. We address this challenge through PE in the following section.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的推论中,用户请求通常会提供参考和简短的指令而未具体说明每个参考的完整约束结构或范围. 因此,剩下的挑战是将这些未明确的要求转化为培训中使用的相同范围、剩余充足和符合授权的字幕分发。 在下一节中,我们通过体育教育应对这一挑战。

blocks.en: 5 Prompt Enhancement: From User Intent to the Caption Distribution

blocks.en:
Captioning determines the language that the generator learns
(Sections 3 and 4 ); PE
determines whether inference-time requests arrive in that
language. Production requests are often short and colloquial or, increasingly,
long passages written by other AI models, whereas the generator is trained on dense captions that
describe subjects, action phases, camera movements, lighting, shots, and sound with a consistent
vocabulary and sentence style. PE rewrites a request into a condition drawn
from this caption distribution while preserving the user’s intent [ 72 ] .
HunyuanVideo established learned prompt rewriting for video
generation [ 19 ] , and RAPO showed that
retrieval can move prompts toward the training distribution [ 9 ] .

blocks.en:
We split PE into two modules (Figure 5 ). Basic PE is the trained rewriter that produces the final condition in the caption dialect. Agentic PE runs before it at inference and decides what that condition
should contain: it makes the story coherent and retrieves compelling examples.
Our experience across Kling releases can be distilled into five lessons, the first
three concerning basic PE and the last two concerning agentic PE.
(1) PE output must match captions in wording and sentence patterns as well as in
format; we achieve this by constructing data backward from captions of compelling
videos.
(2) Much of the gain comes from making the text faithful, reasonable, and vivid,
which can be verified and optimized without running the generator.
(3) Reinforcement learning (RL) with the DiT in the loop then aligns PE with
product objectives and stabilizes quality, at a measurable cost in peak vividness.
(4) Contradictions in AI-written prompts are best resolved by a story-refinement
step before basic PE.
(5) Retrieving compelling captions raises vividness, provided that training uses
strict rejection sampling.

blocks.en: 5.1 Basic PE: Caption Alignment through Backward Construction
blocks.zh: 5.1 基本PE:通过后向建筑对齐说明

blocks.en:
A user request always contains text and may also include images,
videos, or audio clips as references. Basic PE rewrites only the text. It keeps
every reference pointer in the instruction intact but does not modify the
attached media, which reach the generator unchanged
(Section 4 ). The alignment problem discussed below
therefore concerns the text condition alone.

视频,或作为参考的音频片段。 Basic PE只重写文本. 它会保持
指令中每个参考指针都完好无损,但不修改
所附介质,到达生成器不变
(第4节) 下文讨论的调整问题

blocks.en:
Two conditions with similar semantics can produce visibly different videos when
their length, slot order, terminology, or sentence structure differ. A generic
LLM rewriter tends to write metaphors, evaluative adjectives, motivational
clauses, and long subordinate sentences. Such text reads well but lies outside
the caption distribution: the generator spends conditioning capacity on
language patterns it has rarely seen and may ignore controls phrased in unfamiliar
terms. We therefore require alignment at three levels: format , meaning
field order, length regime, and shot and timestamp markers; lexicon ,
meaning the camera, lighting, and action terms of the caption pipeline; and sentence patterns , meaning the declarative, present-tense,
entity-explicit sentences of production captions. Matching format alone leaves
the other two levels free to drift. Figure 6 contrasts typical generic rewrites with caption-aligned output at each level.

字段顺序、长度制度、射击和时间戳标记;
意思是相机,照明,和动作术语 标题管道; 和句子模式, 意思是宣示性,现成性,

blocks.en:
The most reliable way to achieve alignment at all three levels is to use real captions as training
targets. We construct the data backward: starting from the caption of a real
video, a teacher model writes the user prompt that could have produced it, and
PE learns the mapping from prompt to caption. Synthetic prompts follow the
statistics of real traffic rather than the teacher’s own style. For each pair
we sample a target length, language mixture, register, typo rate, and set of
omitted slots from logged queries, and include references, multi-shot requests,
and explicit exclusions at their observed frequencies. Prompts that leak the
caption’s skeleton, for example by listing every action phase in caption order,
are rejected, since PE would otherwise learn copying instead of completion.
Exclusions follow the same principle. Captions describe what is visible, so PE
rewrites “no people” as “an empty street with unobstructed pavement” and
routes exclusions without a positive equivalent either to a negative-conditioning
field or to sampling-time rejection.

blocks.en:
Backward construction also fixes the creative ceiling of PE, because the model
learns to write like its target captions. If source captions are a random
sample of training videos, most targets describe ordinary footage with static
framing and uneventful action, and PE learns to expand every request into a
competent but flat description. We therefore draw source captions mainly from
videos that are compelling in themselves, such as professionally shot scenes,
performances with clear dramatic beats, and clips with deliberate camera
design, selected using aesthetic and motion scores and the vividness metric
of Section 5.2 . Domain and length quotas prevent this
selection from collapsing onto a few genres.

framing, even lighting, and uneventful action. Choosing compelling source
videos addresses this in the data, before any change to the model or the
objective.

blocks.en: 5.2 Text-Level Quality: Faithfulness, Reasonableness, and Vividness
blocks.zh: 5.2 文本层面的质量:忠诚、合理和活力

blocks.en:
Optimizing PE through the generator is expensive: every rollout requires video
sampling and judging, and video-level rewards are noisy. A large fraction of
the end-to-end gain is available earlier, from the text alone. Reasonableness
deserves particular attention. The DiT is trained almost exclusively on real
or carefully produced videos, so it has rarely seen a condition that describes
an impossible scene. When the text contains a spatial contradiction, an object
that changes identity, or an interaction without a physical cause, the
generator has no supervised behavior to fall back on and improvises freely.
The result appears as identity drift, inconsistent layouts, objects passing
through one another, or hands that never make contact. Unreasonable text is
thus one of the most direct causes of consistency and interaction failures.

端到端的收益可以更早地从文本中获取。 合理性

blocks.en:
We measure three properties, each scored on a scale from 1 to 5, and use them in two
places: every supervised fine-tuning (SFT) pair must pass all three verifiers, and the same scores serve
as rewards for text-level RL.

我们测量三个属性,每个属性在1到5的分级上,然后用到两个
位置:每对有监督的微调(SFT)必须全部通过三个验证员,同样的分数服务
作为文本级RL的奖励。

blocks.en:
Faithfulness measures whether the output preserves user intent. A
judge decomposes the user prompt into a checklist of atomic requirements
covering entities, attributes, counts, actions, spatial relations, camera
instructions, quoted text, audio, reference bindings, and exclusions. It then
marks each item in the PE output as satisfied, violated, or unaddressed.
Violations weigh more than omissions, and an addition that contradicts an item
counts as a violation. The checklist makes the score attributable, because a
regression can be traced to the requirement type that failed.

blocks.en:
Reasonableness measures whether the described video could exist. The
judge reads the output sentence by sentence and incrementally builds two
graphs. The spatial graph links entities by relative position, contact,
containment, and viewpoint over time; the interaction graph links
agents, actions, and patients together with their preconditions and resulting
states. Each new sentence is checked against both graphs and against world
knowledge: whether positions remain consistent, whether an object used in an
action is present, whether a result follows from its cause, and whether the
number of events fits the duration. Each conflict lowers the score and is
reported together with the sentence that introduced it. For example, in “the
man sets the cup on the table and walks to the door; he takes a sip as he opens
it,” the spatial graph places the cup on the table and the man at the door, so
the final interaction lacks its object. A generator conditioned on this text
must either duplicate the cup or teleport it, and both outcomes appear as
artifacts.

Vividness measures expressive richness. The judge extracts expressive
elements along several axes, including performance and facial expression,
camera movement and shot design, lighting and color, pacing, and sound design.
It matches them against a curated library of professional techniques compiled
from compelling videos and cinematographic references, and the score increases
with the number of distinct, contextually appropriate hits. Hits are
deduplicated per axis and capped, and only elements that pass the
reasonableness check are counted, so stacking technical terms does not raise
the score.

vocabulary regime, protecting the alignment of
Section 5.1 . Because no video is rendered, this stage

Insight Solve text problems in text. Faithfulness, reasonableness, and
vividness can be verified without rendering a single frame. Removing these
defects before involving the generator makes end-to-end RL cheaper and its

be genuine generation limits.

blocks.en: 5.3 DiT-in-the-Loop RL
blocks.zh: 5.3 二T-in-the-Loop RL

blocks.en:
Text-level judges approximate what the generator needs, but they cannot observe
how a specific checkpoint responds to a condition. In the final training stage,
we connect PE to the frozen text encoder and DiT, sample several rewrites per
prompt, render a video for each, and update PE with a group-relative policy
gradient on video-level rewards. All three rewards come from the decision
reward model of Section 7 : visual quality and motion
quality, the latter covering structural, physical, and temporal artifacts, are
read from its taxonomy fields, and text alignment between the rendered video
and the user prompt is scored by its checklist fields
(Section 7.2 ).
This stage aligns PE with product
objectives and checkpoint-specific behavior, including which camera
moves the current model executes reliably, while reducing quality variance
across prompts and seeds.

The order of the stages matters. DiT-in-the-loop RL starts from the text-level RL

the video rewards spend their limited sample budget on checkpoint-specific
behavior instead of on defects that a text judge could have caught. Because
each update requires rendering several videos per prompt, this stage uses far
fewer prompts than text-level RL, and those prompts are chosen to cover product
domains and the failure slices found in production.

are precisely the descriptions with the highest artifact risk.

A plausible explanation is that all three rewards penalize risk. None of them

the text-level RL checkpoint, and selecting checkpoints based on ceiling as well as floor
metrics. Rewarding ambition directly without reintroducing artifacts remains
an open problem.

blocks.en: 5.4 Agentic PE: Story Refinement and Retrieval

blocks.en:
Basic PE is trained primarily for faithfulness. Reasonableness and vividness
act on it as floors: its output must be no less reasonable and no less vivid
than the user’s input, and every detail it adds must itself be reasonable. It
is not, however, the place where the input itself is rethought: repairing a
contradiction that the user wrote would require departing from that input.
Agentic PE takes that role at inference.
It runs before basic PE and performs two steps: story refinement makes the
requested plot coherent, and retrieval supplies captions of compelling videos
as creative evidence. Its output is still a user-level specification plus
optional context; basic PE always writes the final condition, so the caption
dialect learned in Sections 5.1 – 5.3 is preserved regardless of what agentic PE adds. This division keeps creative
decisions inspectable and lets each part be evaluated against its own
objective.

In production, many user prompts are themselves written by AI models through
scripting assistants or upstream agent pipelines. These prompts are long and
fluent but often internally inconsistent: a character’s clothing changes
between paragraphs, a scene is both indoors and outdoors, more events are
planned than the duration allows, or an action depends on an object that was
never introduced. Asking basic PE alone to repair them places two conflicting
goals on one model, since faithfulness asks it to preserve what the user wrote
while reasonableness asks it to change it.

plot and leaves caption language to basic PE. It detects contradictions with

applies minimal edits that restore coherence while keeping the core intent, and
passes the revised prompt on. Basic PE treats the refined prompt as
authoritative and concentrates on translation into the caption distribution,
without pressure to silently rewrite the story.

as quoted dialogue, counts, reference bindings, and requested camera moves are
never edited unless two of them conflict, in which case the refiner makes the
smallest change that resolves the conflict and records the decision. Second, its edits are minimal and

does not introduce new characters or change the premise. Third, its output is
checked by the reasonableness judge and by a faithfulness checklist computed
on the non-conflicting part of the original prompt, before it reaches basic PE.
When no coherent edit exists, the refiner can pass the prompt through unchanged
with a conflict flag, so that the product can ask the user instead of guessing.

blocks.en: 5.6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.6 讨论情况

blocks.en:
PE translates user intent into the language the generator was trained on, and
it does so through two modules. Basic PE owns the caption dialect. Backward
construction from compelling videos aligns its output with captions in format,
wording, and sentence patterns, while also setting its creative ceiling.
Faithfulness, reasonableness, and vividness verification, applied first as a
data filter and then as text-level rewards, removes the defects most likely to
make the generator improvise. DiT-in-the-loop RL aligns basic PE with product
objectives and raises the quality floor, at a current cost in peak vividness.
Agentic PE owns the content: story refinement resolves contradictions in
AI-written prompts, and retrieval supplies compelling examples, so that no
single module carries every responsibility. Two directions remain open:
rewards that credit ambitious but executable content, and joint training of
agentic PE and basic PE against shared verifiers.

blocks.en: 6.1 Representation Evaluation Beyond General Proxies
blocks.zh: 6.1 一般代理以外的代表评价

blocks.en:
Selecting a TE requires measuring whether its frozen hidden states resolve a
prompt as a fine-grained scene specification. However, common lightweight
proxies—general comprehension benchmarks and retrieval metrics—are
structurally mismatched with how a DiT uses the encoder [ 23 ] .
When serving as a TE, the encoder performs only a prefill forward pass and
supplies a sequence of token-level hidden states 𝐇 cond \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{cond}} to
the DiT. General QA and comprehension benchmarks instead evaluate autoregressive decoding , measuring generated token outputs rather than
the underlying hidden states used for conditioning. Cross-modal retrieval,
meanwhile, evaluates single-vector matching , pooling the entire prompt
into one vector rather than preserving the sequence dimension that the DiT
attends to throughout generation. Evaluating a TE for video conditioning
should therefore operate directly on sequence-level hidden
states [ 23 ] .

blocks.en: 6.2 Adapting Foundation Backbones for Video Conditioning
blocks.zh: 6.2 为视频条件调整后骨基

blocks.en:
Current foundation models increasingly prioritize agentic capabilities over
multimodal perception. Even among multimodal models, training spans a wide
variety of task types with a heavy emphasis on visually grounded agent workflows. While
such broad supervision produces versatile general-purpose assistants, it does
not specialize the backbone’s hidden states for the dense spatiotemporal
grounding required by video conditioning. Empirical evidence supports
this distinction: although multimodal pre-training improves generative
conditioning over pure-text LLMs, broad multi-task instruction tuning offers no
reliable gain, and reasoning-oriented post-training can even
degrade prefill hidden states when it shifts capacity from descriptive
grounding toward step-by-step deduction [ 23 ] .

blocks.en: 6.3 Multi-Granular Semantic Conditioning
blocks.zh: 6.3 多角语义条件

blocks.en:
Beyond adapting the backbone weights, effective conditioning also depends on how
features are extracted from the TE. Video-generation prompts are inherently
multi-granular and hierarchical: at the local level, they specify visible text,
appearance, and instantaneous actions; at the relational level, they bind
attributes to entities and encode spatial or temporal interactions; at the
global level, they organize scene context, shot progression, and narrative
intent. The TE exhibits a
related hierarchy across its depth, with different layers capturing
complementary levels of lexical, relational, and conceptual
abstraction [ 12 , 22 ] . Exposing only a single layer to the
DiT therefore creates a structural mismatch between the multi-granular prompt
and the representation supplied to the generator. Instead, the conditioning
interface should aggregate information across encoder layers so that local
details remain anchored to relational structure and global scene context.

blocks.en: 6.4 Stable Conditioning During Diffusion Training
blocks.zh: 6.4 扩散培训期间的稳定条件

blocks.en:
Combining features across multiple TE layers typically relies on a learnable
fusion module optimized alongside the DiT. However, diffusion training is
inherently non-stationary: the generator primarily optimizes coarse-grained
structure in early training and gradually shifts toward fine-grained details in
later stages, while training configurations such as timestep sampling and video
resolution also change across stages. Because different TE layers capture
different semantic granularities, these shifting optimization targets
continuously pull the fusion module toward different layer combinations. Rather
than converging to a stationary weighting, the fusion module exhibits fusion instability —its layer weights continue to drift or fluctuate
throughout training [ 23 , 22 ] .
