blocks.en: 6.6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 6.6 讨论

blocks.en:
The TE is more than a passive linguistic lookup module attached to the DiT: it
is the component that maps multimodal understanding into the continuous
conditioning space of the generator. While captioning, RGC, and PE express
multimodal understanding explicitly as structured text, the TE converts that
text into an implicit, multi-granular scene representation—screened at the
sequence level, adapted for spatiotemporal perception, aggregated across
encoder layers, and stabilized throughout diffusion training.

blocks.en: 7 Reward Models: Turning Understanding into an Optimization Signal
blocks.zh: 7 奖励模式:将理解转化为优化信号

blocks.en:
The preceding sections construct a semantic contract across the video generation
pipeline: captioning specifies what training videos contain, RGC states what
should be preserved or modified, PE translates user requests into that
contract, and the TE determines which distinctions reach the generator.
Post-training and inference-time selection require an explicit optimization
direction to enforce this contract: among candidate rollouts, the system must
determine which video should be assigned a higher probability and identify
which specific regions or time intervals failed and why. A reward model (RM)
supplies this executable utility signal.

sub-dimensions

models requires scoring thousands of rollouts across dozens of dimensions

At each placeholder, normalizing the option-letter logits over that field’s
options yields a continuous score and probability in one forward pass.
Because placeholders are fixed in the prefix rather than decoded
autoregressively, earlier answers cannot leak into later fields, reinforced by
option-letter randomization, field permutation, and placeholder-only loss
masking. The DRM is trained in three steps: • Step 1: Decision-Head Warm-up. With the backbone frozen, we train only the decision head on generic
multiple-choice corpora (VQA, preference, and tool-use samples), then
unfreeze the full model on video critiques with vote-aggregated soft
labels and on temporal localization. Each field is supervised with soft
cross-entropy over its options, plus a ranked probability score (RPS) term
for ordinal fields. • Step 2: Unified Pointwise–Pairwise SFT and TA Grounding. We fine-tune jointly on single-video defect and checklist items and on
two-video packs that carry per-video and pairwise fields, so that defect
sensitivity and pairwise discrimination are learned in the same prefill.
Text alignment is strengthened with instruction-following pairs and with
audiovisual checklists comprising several atomic questions per video. As an
auxiliary task, a randomly sampled subset of checklist items in each
training sample is paired with temporal fields, one binary field per
one-second bin, to mark when the prompted event occurs; this anchors
alignment decisions to the frames that support them and improves the
judgment of event timing and temporal order. • Step 3: Symmetry Calibration and Gated Inference. Causal/linear attention and M-RoPE [ 54 ] induce position
bias across video order [ 70 ] , and
the worse and better fields of one dimension can disagree;
averaging over swapped orders and both polarities costs two to four passes
per pair. We instead place both polarities in one prefill and regularize
training with (i) a symmetric KL between the worse field and
the option-swapped better field of each dimension and (ii) a cross-order Bradley–Terry loss [ 3 ] between
original and order-swapped packs. At inference, a confidence gate invokes
the swapped pass only on low-margin cases, matching multi-pass accuracy at
near-single-pass latency; when invoked, the second pass uses complementary
dense/sparse frame sampling to catch transient collapses within the
context limit.

blocks.en: 8 Automatic Evaluation: Measuring What Each Task Requires
blocks.zh: 8 自动评价:衡量每项任务所需的内容

blocks.en:
Automatic evaluation serves as the measurement layer for video generation.
While training loss can indicate optimization failures, it cannot directly assess whether generated videos satisfy task-specific requirements, such as correct actions, consistent identity preservation, or audiovisual alignment.
These properties must instead be evaluated on the generated outputs.
Accordingly, the objective is not to design a single universal video quality score, but to determine four fundamental aspects of evaluation: the target task, the failure modes that matter, the tools capable of detecting them, and the reliability of the resulting measurements.
Table 19 summarizes the first three aspects for each major task; measurement reliability is discussed below.
blocks.zh:
自动评价是视频生成的测量层。
虽然培训损失可能表明优化失败,但它无法直接评估生成的视频是否满足特定任务的要求,如正确的行动,一致的身份保护,或视听校正等.
相反,这些属性必须根据产生的产出加以评价。
因此,目标不是设计一个单一的普及视频质量分数,而是确定评价的四个基本方面:目标任务,重要的故障模式,能够检测的工具,以及由此产生的测量的可靠性.
表19总结了每项主要任务的头三个方面;下文讨论测量可靠性。

blocks.en: 8.1 Task Taxonomy: What Should Be Evaluated?
blocks.zh: 8.1 任务分类: 怎样评价?

blocks.en:
The evaluation protocol should be defined by the underlying generation task.
Different tasks have distinct success criteria and correspondingly different failure modes.
More importantly, they differ in the ways in which models can achieve high evaluation scores without genuinely satisfying the intended objective.
blocks.zh:
评价协议应由基本的生成任务来界定。
不同的任务有不同的成功标准,相应的失败模式也有所不同.
更重要的是,这些模式在模式在不真正满足预期目标的情况下达到高评价分数的方式上有所不同。

blocks.en:
Lexical-overlap metrics such as BLEU and CIDEr penalize valid paraphrases and are poorly suited to dense video descriptions.
Recent benchmarks therefore shift from wording similarity to semantic coverage, decomposing video content into atomic keypoints and verifying whether each fact is correctly expressed.
VidCapBench [ 6 ] exemplifies this paradigm with 643 videos and 10,644 QA pairs spanning aesthetics, content, motion, and physical laws, while distinguishing items suitable for automatic evaluation from those requiring human judgment.
CapRiCorn-1K [ 5 ] extends this paradigm to long videos by also evaluating referential consistency, testing whether entities remain consistently identified across time and shots.
For comparative captioning, factual coverage alone is insufficient: similarities and differences must be evaluated separately, as in ViDiC [ 60 ] .
Caption evaluation should also demonstrate downstream validity.
VidCapBench reports correlations of 0.89–0.92 between caption accuracy and downstream text-to-video generation quality, while CapRiCorn-1K shows that caption quality correlates strongly with long-video reasoning and video reconstruction performance.
These results highlight a key criterion for caption evaluation: a metric should guide data or captioner design only if improvements in the metric translate into measurable downstream gains.
blocks.zh:
诸如BLEU和CIDEr等线性重叠度量衡会惩罚有效的释法并不适合密集的视频描述.
因此,最近的基准从措辞相似转向语义覆盖,将视频内容分解为原子关键点,并核实每个事实是否得到正确表达。
VidCap Bench [6] 以643个视频和10,644个QA对贯穿美学、内容、运动和物理定律的组合来说明这一范例,同时将适合自动评价的项目与需要人类判断的项目区分开来。
CapRiCorn-1K [5] 将这一范式扩展至长相视频,同时通过评价特长一致性,测试实体是否在时间和镜头中始终被识别.
就比较性说明而言,仅是事实报道是不够的:类似之处和差异必须单独评估,如《国际商业合同》[60]。
说明评价还应显示下游的有效性。
VidCap Bench报告说,标题精度与下游文本到视频生成质量之间的相关性为0.89-0.92;而CapRiCorn-1K显示,标题质量与长视频推理和视频重建性能密切相关。
这些结果突出了标题评价的一个关键标准:只有在衡量标准的改进转化为可衡量的下游收益时,衡量标准才能指导数据或标题设计。

blocks.en: Table 19 : Evaluation taxonomy by task.
blocks.zh: 表19:按任务分列的评价分类。

blocks.en:
Text-to-video evaluation should distinguish instruction following, perceptual quality, and physical or commonsense plausibility.
VBench [ 17 ] decomposes video quality into 16 dimensions rather than collapsing them into a single score, while VBench-2.0 [ 69 ] further extends evaluation to human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense.
For compositional prompts, attributes, spatial relations, interactions, and motion are evaluated with specialized tools, as no single similarity metric reliably captures all these aspects [ 47 ] .
Audio introduces additional dimensions that must be evaluated independently.
T2AV-Compass [ 4 ] and LongAV-Compass [ 30 ] jointly assess video and audio quality, text–video and text–audio alignment, audiovisual synchronization, instruction following, and realism.
Their results reveal substantial asymmetry across these dimensions: strong video quality does not necessarily imply realistic audio or consistent material–timbre correspondence.
This distinction is fundamental: instruction-following checklists measure whether the requested content is present, whereas realism criteria assess whether that content is perceptually and physically plausible.
blocks.zh:
文本到视频评价应区分以下指示、感知质量和物理或常识可信度。
V Bench [17] 将视频质量分解为16个维度,而不是将其分解为一分;而V Bench-2.0 [69] 进一步将评价延伸到了人类的忠诚,可控性,创造性,物理,和常识.
对于成份提示,属性、空间关系、相互作用和运动用专门的工具加以评价,因为没有单一的相似性指标可靠地反映所有这些方面[47]。
音频引入了必须独立评价的其他维度.
T2AV-Compass [4]和LongAV-Compass [30] 联合评估视频和音频质量,文本-视频和文本-音频对接,视听同步,指令跟随,现实主义.
其结果表明,这些方面存在着严重的不对称现象:强有力的录像质量并不一定意味着现实的音频或一致的材料 -- -- 严酷的通信。
这种区分是根本的:按照指示核对表衡量所要求的内容是否存在,而现实主义标准则评估该内容是否在概念上和物理上是可信的。

blocks.en:
Reference-conditioned generation requires more than embedding similarity.
Evaluation should account for entity identity, fine-grained details, role binding, and natural integration.
MultiRef-Compass [ 67 ] further introduces an anti-paste coefficient, EF final = EF base ​ P paste , \mathrm{EF}_{\mathrm{final}}=\mathrm{EF}_{\mathrm{base}}P_{\mathrm{paste}}, (2) which penalizes direct copying of reference content and prevents copy–paste behavior from inflating fidelity scores.
Keyframe-conditioned generation introduces an additional temporal dimension: detecting whether a keyframe appears is necessary but insufficient.
KeyFrame-Compass [ 48 ] therefore decomposes keyframe response into presence, visual fidelity, temporal order, temporal position, persistence, and response uniqueness.
This decomposition distinguishes successful temporal integration from failure modes such as slideshow-like transitions, transient flashes, prolonged freezes, and reversed sequences.
The same principle generalizes to other temporally controlled settings, including first- and last-frame-conditioned generation, shot planning, and camera trajectory control.
blocks.zh:
参照条件生成需要的不仅仅是嵌入相似性.
评价应说明实体身份、详细细节、角色约束和自然融合。
MultiRef-Compass [67] 进一步引入了反粘贴系数, EF Final = EF Base P sade,\mathrm{ EF}_{\ mathrm{ final}}=\ mathrm{ EF}_{\ mathrm{ base}} P_{\ mathrm{ paste}, (2) 惩罚直接复制参考内容,防止复制-复制行为夸大忠诚分数。
具有关键框架条件的生成增加了时间层面:检测一个关键框架是否有必要,但还不够。
因此,KeyFrame-Compass [48] 将关键框架反应分解为存在、视觉忠诚、时间顺序、时间位置、持久性和反应的独特性。
这种分解将成功的时空融合与失败模式区分开来,如幻灯片般的过渡,瞬时闪出,被长时间地冻结,以及倒置等.
同一原则一般适用于其他有时间控制的设置,包括第一和最后帧条件的生成、拍摄规划和相机轨迹控制。

blocks.en:
Video editing must satisfy two competing objectives: the requested content should change, while unrelated content should remain intact.
CoVEBench [ 61 ] decomposes complex editing instructions into atomic checks and separately evaluates instruction compliance, output quality, and source fidelity.
AVE-Compass [ 57 ] extends this evaluation to joint audio–video editing.
Its Editing Intent score is defined for each case and each modality as EI M ( c ) = IF M ( c ) ​ FP M ( c ) , \mathrm{EI}^{(c)}_{M}=\mathrm{IF}^{(c)}_{M}\mathrm{FP}^{(c)}_{M}, (3) where IF measures instruction following and FP measures fidelity preservation.
The multiplicative formulation ensures that neither leaving the source unchanged nor regenerating it indiscriminately can achieve a high score.
Response gating provides an additional safeguard: preservation and realism are evaluated only when the target modality responds to the edit, while non-responses are retained as instruction-following failures.
blocks.zh:
视频编辑必须满足两个相互竞争的目标:要求的内容应当改变,而无关的内容应当保持完整.
CoVE Bench [61] 将复杂的编辑指令分解为原子检查,并单独评价指令的合规性,输出质量,和源忠.
AVE-Compass [57] 将这一评价扩展至联合音频-视频编辑.
其编辑意向分数被每个案例和每个模式定义为: EI M (c) = IF M (c) FP M (c) ,\mathrm{ EI}^{ (c) }_{-M}=\- mathrm{ IF}^{ (c) }_{-M}\- mathrm{ FP}^{ (c)}_{-M},其中IF的计量指令遵循并被FP计量忠诚保全.
多种配方确保既不能使来源保持不变,也不能不加区别地重新产生来源,从而达到高分。
响应配乐提供了另一个保障:只有当目标模式响应编辑时,才对保存和现实性进行评价,而非响应则作为指令后继失败保留.

blocks.en: 8.2 Evaluation Tools and Reliability: How Can Each Property Be Measured Accurately?
blocks.zh: 8.2 评价工具和可靠性:如何准确衡量每个财产?

blocks.en:
No single tool observes every property of a generated video.
Signal-based and embedding-based metrics such as DOVER++, CLIP, CLAP, and Synchformer are inexpensive and stable, yet they capture only global quality and similarity.
Specialist perception models, including detectors, trackers, and identity or speech models, add localized evidence about where and when an entity or change appears.
MLLM checklist judges [ 13 ] cover the remaining semantic requirements that resist simple measurement.
In practice, each property is routed to the simplest tool able to observe it reliably, with specialist evidence grounding the semantic judgments.
blocks.zh:
没有单个工具观察到生成的视频的每个属性.
基于信号的和基于嵌入的度量衡,如DOVER++,CLIP,CLAP,和Synchformer都是廉价而稳定的,但它们只捕捉到全球质量和相似性.
专家感知模型,包括探测器,跟踪器,以及身份或语音模型,会添加关于某一实体或变化出现地点和时间的局部证据.
MLLM核对表法官[13]涵盖其余的语义要求,这些要求抵制简单的测量.
在实践中,每个财产都通向能够可靠地观察它的最简单的工具,专家证据支撑着语义判断.

blocks.en:
Accurate evaluation, however, depends as much on protocol design as on the tools themselves.
Holistic ratings should be replaced by atomic, directly observable criteria, and competing requirements should be scored jointly so that trivial shortcuts—such as leaving a video unedited or pasting a reference—cannot inflate the result.
Frame rate, resolution, and token budget belong to the protocol rather than to implementation details; a genuine temporal metric must change when temporal evidence is removed or shuffled [ 36 ] .
Automatic judges also require calibration against human annotations and explicit control of known biases [ 70 ] , together with a fixed configuration for reproducibility.
Finally, reporting results per dimension and difficulty slice exposes weaknesses that a single aggregate score would hide, while hidden prompts and periodic human review guard against benchmark overfitting.
blocks.zh:
然而,准确评价既取决于协议设计,也取决于工具本身。
整体评分应该取而代之的是直接可观察到的原子标准,相互竞争的要求应该共同评分,这样一些微不足道的捷径——如留下未经编辑的视频或粘贴参考文献——不能夸大结果。
框架率、分辨率和象征性预算属于协议,而不是执行细节;在删除或删除时间证据时,真正的时间尺度必须改变[36]。
自动法官还要求对照人的说明进行校准,并明确控制已知的偏差[70],以及固定的可复制配置。
最后,报告每个维度和困难片段的结果暴露出单一汇总分数会隐藏的弱点,而隐藏的提示和定期人力审查则防止基准过度调整。

blocks.en: 8.3 Operational Evaluation: How Should Evaluation Be Used in Practice?
blocks.zh: 8.3 业务评价:如何将评价用于实践?

blocks.en:
The same evaluation taxonomy can be instantiated at three cost levels.
An hourly smoke test relies on deterministic signal-based metrics and a small set of high-agreement checklist items.
A daily regression board adds specialist evidence, stable MLLM-based checks, a fixed anchor model, and performance deltas across difficulty levels.
A release-level evaluation runs the full routed protocol on challenging public benchmarks and hidden prompts, with repeated judging and human calibration.
These levels differ in evaluator configuration and rigor rather than merely in the number of evaluated samples.
blocks.zh:
同样的评价分类学可以在三个成本级别上被即时化.
小时烟雾测试依靠基于确定信号的衡量尺度和少量高协议清单项目。
每日回归板增加了专家证据、稳定的基于MLLM的检查、固定锚定模型和跨难度水平的性能三角洲。
发布级评价运行关于挑战公共基准和隐藏提示的全路由协议,反复判断和人校正.
这些等级在评价者的配置和严格程度方面不同,而不只是在评价的样本数量方面。

blocks.en:
Evaluation outputs should ultimately support diagnosis.
For each failure, the system should retain the evaluation criterion, sampled evidence, tool outputs, judge rationale, and likely upstream source.
Caption failures should be traced back to annotation or captioning, reference-binding failures to conditioning, realism failures to generation or reward modeling, and evaluator disagreements to protocol calibration.
A useful benchmark should therefore do more than rank models: it should identify which capability fails, under what conditions, and where in the generation pipeline the failure originates.
blocks.zh:
评价产出最终应支持诊断。
对于每次失败,系统应保留评价标准、抽样证据、工具产出、判断理由和可能的上游来源。
说明失败应可追溯到注释或标题、对条件的参照约束力的失败、对生成或奖励模型的现实主义的失败以及评价者对协议校正的分歧。
因此,一个有用的基准应不止是分级模式:它应确定哪些能力失灵,在何种条件下失效,以及故障在发电管道中源于何处。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
This report summarizes the observations and insights into multimodal
understanding that we gained from successive generations of Kling,
viewing generation quality as the projection of understanding through the
entire data–conditioning–alignment–evaluation chain. Kling-MLLM, a shared
multimodal foundation model, provides the perceptual foundation for every
downstream module. Captioning serves as a dense semantic contract for training,
and RGC extends this contract with explicit reference bindings. PE translates user intent
into this caption distribution, with agentic steps that refine the story and
retrieve compelling examples. A reliable TE comes from perceptual training and
multi-layer fusion, and candidate TEs can be screened from text alone. Reward
modeling pairs an explainable GRM with a fast DRM, treating perceptual bandwidth
as a primary design parameter. For automatic
evaluation, our review suggests that protocols should follow the task, expose
scoring shortcuts, and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for
building the understanding stack that supports controllable video generation.
